error.purpose: Shown when switching an online service on or off could not be saved.
error.where: Settings, Online services, under the service's switch.

musicBrainz.label.purpose: Name of the switch for MusicBrainz lookups.

musicBrainz.help.purpose: Says the switch is off by default and exactly what MusicBrainz is sent.
musicBrainz.help.where: Settings, Online services, under the MusicBrainz switch.

acoustId.label.purpose: Name of the switch for AcoustID lookups.

acoustId.help.purpose: Says the switch is off by default and exactly what AcoustID is sent (a fingerprint and the track's length).
acoustId.help.where: Settings, Online services, under the AcoustID switch.

acoustId.unavailable.purpose: Why the AcoustID switch can't be used: this build has no AcoustID application key yet.
acoustId.unavailable.where: Settings, Online services, under the AcoustID help, while the key is missing.

discogs.label.purpose: Name of the switch for Discogs lookups.

discogs.help.purpose: Says the switch is off by default, what Discogs is sent, and that it uses the user's own token.
discogs.help.where: Settings, Online services, under the Discogs switch.

discogs.tokenLabel.purpose: Label of the password field for the Discogs token.
discogs.tokenLabel.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, while the switch is on.

discogs.save.purpose: Button: check the typed token with Discogs and keep it if accepted.
discogs.save.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, beside the token field.

discogs.saving.purpose: Status while the typed token is being checked online.
discogs.saving.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, under the token field.

discogs.remove.purpose: Button: forget the saved Discogs token.
discogs.remove.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, beside the token field.

discogs.removed.purpose: Confirms the saved token was removed.
discogs.removed.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Remove token.

discogs.saved.purpose: Says a Discogs token is saved (the token itself is never shown).
discogs.saved.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, while the switch is on.

discogs.notSaved.purpose: Says no Discogs token is saved.
discogs.notSaved.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, while the switch is on.

discogs.getLabel.purpose: Introduces the address where the user gets a Discogs token. The app never opens it.
discogs.getLabel.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, under the token field.

discogs.tokenUrl.purpose: The Discogs page where a token is made, shown as text to copy. The app never opens it.
discogs.tokenUrl.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after the line about getting a token.

discogs.copy.purpose: Button: copy the Discogs token address.
discogs.copy.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, beside the address.

discogs.copied.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Copy.

discogs.copyFailed.purpose: Says copying failed and tells the user to copy the address by hand.
discogs.copyFailed.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Copy.

discogs.outcome.saved.purpose: Result of Save token: Discogs accepted the token and it was kept.
discogs.outcome.saved.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Save token.

discogs.outcome.switchOff.purpose: Result of Save token when the Discogs switch is off: nothing was sent or saved.
discogs.outcome.switchOff.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Save token.

discogs.outcome.empty.purpose: Result of Save token with an empty field.
discogs.outcome.empty.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Save token.

discogs.outcome.storeUnavailable.purpose: Result of Save token, and a note beside the field: this computer has no password store.
discogs.outcome.storeUnavailable.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Save token.

discogs.outcome.rejected.purpose: Result of Save token: Discogs said the token is not valid; nothing was kept.
discogs.outcome.rejected.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Save token.

discogs.outcome.couldNotCheck.purpose: Result of Save token: Discogs could not be reached (offline, busy); nothing was kept.
discogs.outcome.couldNotCheck.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Save token.

discogs.outcome.storeFailed.purpose: Result of Save token: Discogs accepted it but the password store refused it; nothing was kept.
discogs.outcome.storeFailed.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Save token.

discogs.outcome.failed.purpose: Result of Save token or Remove token when the app itself failed.
discogs.outcome.failed.where: Settings, Online services, Discogs, after Save token or Remove token.

coverArt.label.purpose: Name of the switch for Cover Art Archive lookups.

coverArt.help.purpose: Says the switch is off by default and what the Cover Art Archive is asked for.
coverArt.help.where: Settings, Online services, under the Cover Art switch.
